label: preparing
what: A jubilee gathering in the great hall for my forty years as mayor, at eighteen hundred today, coordinated with a lantern inspection and builder escort. Freight, baker, innkeeper and builder are arranging two hundred fresh loaves, transport, ingredients and payment. Secretary knowingly helps confirm arrangements without committing town funds. Originally intended as a surprise, it has since been disclosed to me; final ingredients and freshness remain unconfirmed.
